test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the bracketed segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'no substitution required'.**

(There's many a good tunes) played on an old violin.

options.text: There are many a good tunes

solution:
The correct answer is **"There are many good tunes."**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence has a subject-verb disagreement as '**There's' (contraction of 'there is')** is singular while **'many'** is plural.
 
• We need to replace** "there's"** with **"there're."**
 
• The corrected sentence uses the plural form of the verb **'are' **to match with the plural subject **'many good tunes.'**
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

**Correct sentence**: ***There are many good tunes**__ played on an old violin.*
